title: Linked nonlinear queries and a full-B2 lower bound of 40816655382787/8017315635000

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. experiments.purpose: Both runs are required for either claim. Initial {"phase":"energy"} regenerates all 123635 layer-27 tail pairs from the maximal boundary and compares every pair with the supplied witness. It recomputes energy and initial majority. Request the one follow-up {"phase":"terminal"} to use the same witness, advance 30 more layers, and verify the terminal majority and 72 exact entropy inequalities. Check both runs completed and report the same prefix digest.
